findings.body: api/app.py:100 — `APP_BASE_URL` is used for password reset links but not for Stripe success/cancel URLs. Fix: Consolidate to a single `APP_BASE_URL` environment variable for all external-facing URLs to ensure consistency and prevent misconfiguration.

api/app.py:107 — `MGS_ADMIN_TOKEN` is stored in plaintext in an environment variable. Fix: Hash the admin token (e.g., with bcrypt) and store the hash. Compare the provided token against the hash using `secrets.compare_digest`.

api/app.py:126 — Missing explicit index on `users.email`. Fix: Add `CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS users_email_idx ON users(email);` to the schema. (SQLite implicitly indexes `UNIQUE` columns, but explicit definition is clearer).
api/app.py:136 — Missing index on `sessions.user_id`. Fix: Add `CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS sessions_user_id_idx ON sessions(user_id);` to the schema.
api/app.py:150 — Missing index on `share_links.user_id`. Fix: Add `CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS share_links_user_id_idx ON share_links(user_id);` to the schema.
